relationships.subject: inflammatory soup
relationships.evidence_quote: inflammatory soup increased secretion of CGRP by 3-fold and 5-fold in whole cultures with and without replating compared to corresponding baselines

relationships.subject: sumatriptan
relationships.evidence_quote: inflammatory soup-evoked CGRP release was significantly inhibited in the presence of sumatriptan or topiramate in multiple wild-type lines

relationships.subject: PACAP-38
relationships.evidence_quote: Other known positive stimulants including FK, PACAP-38 (Vollesen and Ashina, 2017), and depolarization signal KCl also significantly increased CGRP release

relationships.subject: astrocytes
relationships.evidence_quote: isolated TG placodal nociceptors co-cultured with primary rat astrocytes now expressed CGRP as confirmed by CGRP/TUJ1 co-expression in 66.78% of the cells

key_findings: Replating whole cultures without placodal isolation yields hiPSC-derived trigeminal peptidergic nociceptors (97.6% TRPV1/CGRP double positive) that release CGRP to inflammatory soup, inhibited by sumatriptan and topiramate.
Placode isolation gives non-peptidergic nociceptors, while astrocyte co-culture induces CGRP expression.
